name: TDCNet-local; local public-config reconstruction, not full TransCG reproduction

scheduler.step: once after training each completed epoch, before validation

loss: TransCG fixed-public Criterion custom_masked_l1_loss + .1 cosine surface-normal; import redirected only
rgb_augmentation: fixed released chromatic_transform and add_noise function bodies; existing RGB/BGR conventions retained
flip: independent vertical and horizontal p=.5; RGB/raw/depth/GT/mask aligned; mirrored principal point and signed focal length
best_metric: 320x240 object MAE, equal image mean, metres; minimize
auxiliary_metrics: pixel pooled MAE/RMSE/signed error, image macro, by camera/scene, missing/nonzero and mask-inner Euclidean edge <=3px/interior
evaluation_scope: researcher-visible official-train scenes held out from this random-init optimization; not untouched test
simple_comparators: copy_nonzero: raw>0 ? raw : network; no GT in branch
